Mutant Feature - Reptile Tail.description:
🐾 Mutant Features: Reptile Tail
A heavy, scaled reptile tail that tapers to a point near the ground.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Mutant Feature - Reptile Tail.traitNarrativeEffects:
Visual selection only: a permanent Mutant feature of the body; keep it in every portrait, even when the Quirk Type is Emitter or Transformation. It adds no Quirk effect, item, license or affiliation; Quirk traits decide what it can do. Features for the same body part (ears, mouth, tail, wings, horns, head or full skin covering) do not stack: draw only the one whose name comes first alphabetically. Quirkless or No Quirk means no heteromorph body: do not draw this feature.
Portrait: a heavy reptile tail grows from the base of the spine through an opening in the clothing, about thigh-wide at the root, tapering to a point that rests near the ground behind the heels. Overlapping scales cover the top and sides, broader smoother scales the underside; scales follow the selected skin color, a shade darker on top. Show it whenever the frame and pose include the lower back or hips.
